summary.intent: Triage and fix confirmed failures from a targeted Codex review (round T1) on the onboarding-friction-fix worktree branch, after the full gate passed on commit 8e4630e7a.
summary.outcome: Fixed three issues test-first (RED then green): the init review line is now written outside the optional-workflow fallback so write failures surface; capture_stream retries Interrupted reads and surfaces other read errors; clap --help/--version now route through the sink so a failing stdout is reported. Changeset updated and a commit was made, with clippy, cli_tests, runner and closed_stream tests checked.

repo: The repo uses a gate script (all six checks) plus targeted Codex review rounds (codex exec -s workspace-write with a prompt file) as a pre-merge workflow; confirmed failures from Codex are triaged and fixed with RED tests first.
cargo test output is run via `rtk proxy cargo ...` and git via `/usr/bin/git`; commit output is filtered with grep to drop moon/progress noise.
Changesets in .changeset/ must be updated when user-visible behavior changes (here covering --help/--version on failing stdout).
trycmd_tests and cli_tests guard help output bytes, so changes to how help is printed should be verified against them.
closed_stream_tests.rs holds tests for behavior when stdout/stderr is closed or failing, including a_storage_failure_still_fails_with_stdout_closed.

code.finding: build_workflow no longer writes the 'default branch' review line and now returns scaffold::DefaultBranch; the new write_default_branch helper is called by the caller so a write failure isn't swallowed by the optional-workflow fallback (match arm on build_workflow in the migration path).

capture_stream now returns io::Result<String>: Interrupted reads are retried, other read errors are returned (previously `Ok(0) | Err(_) => break` silently truncated output). Channels carry io::Result<String> and the caller maps failures to CommandError::Io 'reading its output failed'.
Clap help/version output (ErrorKind) is now written through the Write sink so non-BrokenPipe stdout errors produce a nonzero exit instead of exit 0.

workflow: Write the failing test first and confirm RED (including compile-time red against a new contract) before implementing the fix.
Multi-line source edits were done with python3 scripts using assert-guarded string replacement, which fails loudly if the anchor text doesn't match.
Re-run clippy with -D warnings and the help-output snapshot tests after changing output paths.

friction: The first cargo fmt/git commit attempt used plain `cargo fmt` and was retried with `rtk cargo fmt`, indicating the rtk wrapper is needed in this environment.
Commit output is noisy (moon/progress lines) and needs grep filtering to read.
open_items: A further Codex review round and a final gate re-run are needed on the new commit to confirm the fixes and no regressions.
Commit result (hash/signature status and clean worktree) was not shown in the transcript, so it should be verified.
